existing_system_master_pattern.rule: System Master may adapt specialist-owned truth for coordination without taking specialist semantic ownership.

invariants: System Master calls Documents through artifact references and exact SHA-256 identities only; raw document/manuscript/source bytes are not part of the adapter contract.
DOCUMENTS remains semantic owner of document mechanics; the adapter grants no Book, Learning, Core, Programming, retired Prose, author, private, native, A-01, publication or production authority.
Idempotency key reuse with unchanged semantic request identity is replay-safe; changed semantics under the same key fail with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
Request and correlation identity are preserved at the current invocation boundary, including replay.
Service protocol or transport violations fail closed as classified BLOCKED responses and never synthesize SUCCEEDED.
R4 exact-byte GitHub-native custody is independent of this adapter and remains blocked until exact source bytes cross an approved file-capable transport.
Existing qualified F-WP-010 package bytes and the prior 021F integration binding are not modified by this integration.
